concurrency_statement: No subordinate writer branch, worktree or agent existed during Wave A. Every write in the owned subtree was made by this single sequential worker on the branch named above. No two writers ever ran against this working directory at the same time.
collision_detection_method: Single-writer invariant plus `git status --porcelain` inspection before each commit; no lock service was required because no second writer existed.

worktree_isolation.reason: Isolated worktrees exist to separate concurrent writers. Wave A had exactly one writer, so no isolation boundary was needed. Isolated worktrees or separate cloud VMs remain the correct mechanism if a future wave runs concurrent subordinate writers, and are recorded as available-but-unused in workstreams/po03/evidence/scale-ladder.json.
